protocols.name: platform.file.write
protocols.consumerImpact: Local operator runbook keeps a bounded target write; no legacy command parity is promised (reference shows no external consumer).
protocols.notes: Writes one bounded marker file inside an owned synthetic target directory; never an arbitrary path.

protocols.name: platform.file.probe
protocols.consumerImpact: Read-only local presence check retained; a read creates no effect.
protocols.notes: Observes a bounded target fact through the real filesystem; refuses any caller-supplied path.

protocols.name: platform.credential.presence
protocols.consumerImpact: Credential presence is verified locally without exposing the credential value.
protocols.notes: Real native check: the target credential file must exist as a non-empty regular file with owner-only (0600) permissions; only presence and mode are observed, never the secret content.

protocols.name: platform.target.release
protocols.consumerImpact: Release-class effect kept behind its own destructive-release grant; synthetic targets only.
protocols.notes: Exercised against synthetic targets only; a real release additionally needs the human operator at a real terminal.

protocols.name: evidence.http.read
protocols.consumerImpact: An authenticated evidence HTTP binding stays compatibility-dependent; it is never a public admin bypass and is not mounted here.
protocols.notes: Recorded for parity; not implemented in this unit. The canonical interface is the local stdin/stdout JSON envelope.

protocols.name: platform.cdk.deploy
protocols.consumerImpact: Cloud deployment is a recorded disposition, not a runtime dependency; no paid fallback is added under the $0 budget.
protocols.notes: Recorded only; ops/cdk stacks are cloud-dependent and out of the $0/local budget.

protocols.name: platform.cloudwatch.publish
protocols.consumerImpact: Hosted telemetry is not reproduced; monitoring is a local receipt-derived status view.
protocols.notes: Recorded only; no paid telemetry vendor under the $0 budget.

protocols.name: platform.ses.notify
protocols.consumerImpact: Provider email notification is a recorded disposition; no paid fallback.
protocols.notes: Recorded only; SES is a paid/cloud provider.

u8ProtocolsNote: A6's protocols (U8 plan Step 27). They sit in their own array so U7's loader and bootstrap, which read only `protocols`, keep exactly U7's eight; U8's loader reads both. Each names its fixed targets and its address-space bound.

u8Protocols.name: platform.database.backup
u8Protocols.displayName: Database backup onto the backup volume
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: The backup agent dumps the production or a rehearsal database onto the backup volume (Workflow 5); the schedule's standing authority may run it.
u8Protocols.notes: The agent's unattended `backup` word; the copy's kind follows from the source database.

u8Protocols.name: platform.database.restore
u8Protocols.displayName: Database restore from a passed set
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: A scratch restore for a restore verification (standing authority), or a production restore as a bound step of an active production restore (in person).
u8Protocols.notes: A production target is admitted only at its restore's step (u8_protocols preconditions).

u8Protocols.name: platform.database.recreate
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Recreates the production database empty: a production restore's step, a restore abandonment, an abort or a rollback.
u8Protocols.notes: Refused while live with admission open except as a bound restore step (A6).

u8Protocols.name: platform.database.remove
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Removes a rehearsal, import or scratch database by its fixed name pattern; never the production or the current rehearsal database (BR9.17).
u8Protocols.notes: Waits for an active rehearsal backup or verification.

u8Protocols.name: platform.service.control
u8Protocols.displayName: Service control of one named launch job
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Starts or stops exactly one named launch job; a stop leaves a root-owned stop record citing its receipt.
u8Protocols.notes: Its targets are the platform profile's labels.

u8Protocols.name: platform.tunnel.route
u8Protocols.displayName: Tunnel routing to one registered origin
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Makes one of the three registered origins (v1 web, v2 host, maintenance) the active one (BR6.11, BR9.10).
u8Protocols.notes: The fixed command takes only the origin's name.

u8Protocols.name: platform.isolation.check
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Runs the runtime isolation check, which takes no argument (BR6.12); the standing authority may run it.
u8Protocols.notes: Each item has its own limit; the whole check ends within 60 s.

u8Protocols.name: platform.profile.mode
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Rehearsal or live, only at the cutover's step (BR9.15).
u8Protocols.notes: One profile field per operation, with its receipt identifier in the manifest.

u8Protocols.name: platform.profile.admission
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Maintainer-only or open, only at the cutover's step (BR9.15).

u8Protocols.name: platform.profile.rehearsal-database
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: The rehearsal database the profile runs on, moved when a newer dry run is accepted or cleared at admission opening.
u8Protocols.notes: Only during rehearsal or at admission opening.

u8Protocols.name: platform.profile.backup-volume
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: The backup volume's identity, after your volume-retirement decision (BR4.10).
u8Protocols.notes: Refused while a switch or an abort holds the exclusion.

u8Protocols.name: platform.copy.dispose
u8Protocols.displayName: Retained copy disposal through its place's one path
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Disposes a RetainedCopy's, BackupSet's or LedgerCopy's location through the backup agent or the database removal (BR9.17).
u8Protocols.notes: v1's stores are deleted by you in person, never here.

u8Protocols.name: platform.v1.lifecycle.apply
u8Protocols.displayName: v2's lifecycle outcomes applied to v1
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: A rollback applies v2's lifecycle outcomes through v1's own account code and ends every v1 session (BR9.13).
u8Protocols.notes: Runs backend/modules/accounts/services/v2_rollback_apply.py with v1's runtime from v1's fixed checkout.

u8Protocols.name: platform.decision.record
u8Protocols.displayName: Your decision, bound to the digest you were shown
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Binds the operator, the step, the subject and its digest (Workflow 18, BR9.14).
u8Protocols.notes: Its receipt admits a MaintainerApproval in the ledger.

u8Protocols.name: platform.ledger.copy
u8Protocols.displayName: Ledger copy onto the backup volume
u8Protocols.consumerImpact: Copies the ledger on its own onto the backup volume through the backup agent, with the copy's chain check (BR6.10, NFR4.3).
u8Protocols.notes: Touches no database, so it runs while a switch or a production restore holds the environment.

consumers.notes: The local runbook has no external CLI contract; the canonical v2 envelope replaces it.
Kept authenticated and bounded; never a public admin surface.
No real external consumer is evidenced; no legacy parity is invented.
